```{r}
#load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)

#load data
train <- read_csv("data-train.csv")
data_test <- read_csv("data-test.csv")

#transform data
#making new variables for our summary stats

#mean = R_moment_1, C_moment_2 is variance, everything else is as commented
train <- train %>%
  mutate(
    m1 = R_moment_1, m2 = R_moment_2, m3 = R_moment_3, m4 = R_moment_4,

    # central moments
    C_moment_2 = m2 - m1^2,                               # variance
    C_moment_3 = m3 - 3*m1*m2 + 2*m1^3,
    C_moment_4 = m4 - 4*m1*m3 + 6*m1^2*m2 - 3*m1^4,

    # standardized versions
    sd_R     = sqrt(C_moment_2),
    skewness = C_moment_3 / sd_R^3,
    kurtosis = C_moment_4 / sd_R^4,                       # raw kurtosis
    ex_kurt  = kurtosis - 3                               # excess kurtosis
  )

log_train <- train |>
  mutate(log_mean = log(R_moment_1),
         log_variance = log(C_moment_2), 
         log_skewness = log(skewness),
         log_kurtosis = log(kurtosis),
         inverse_Fr = 1/Fr)


```

```{r}
#eda on our summary stats

train |>
  ggplot(aes(R_moment_1)) +
  geom_histogram()

train |>
  ggplot(aes(C_moment_2)) +
  geom_histogram()

train |>
  ggplot(aes(skewness)) +
  geom_histogram()

train |>
  ggplot(aes(kurtosis)) +
  geom_histogram()

#all of them are skewed right, will apply a log transformation 
```

```{r}
#building the k nearest neighbor model
set.seed(2026)

#fitting mean, testing with loocv 
knn_fit <- caret::train(
  R_moment_1 ~ St + Re + inverse_Fr, data = log_train, method = "knn",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"), #scales and centers
  trControl  = trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5),
  tuneGrid   = data.frame(k = seq(1, 25, 2))      # CV picks k
)
knn_fit          # CV RMSE for each k

knn_loocv <- caret::train(
  R_moment_1 ~ St + Re + inverse_Fr, data = log_train, method = "knn",
  preProcess = c("center", "scale"), #scales and centers
  trControl  = trainControl(method = "LOOCV"),
  tuneGrid   = data.frame(k = seq(1, 25, 2))      # CV picks k
)

plot(knn_fit)
plot(knn_loocv)

```
